summary: BigBlueButton is a video conferencing platform built for online learning and remote classrooms. It facilitates real-time streaming of audio, video, and presentations with collaborative whiteboard controls, chat functionality, and desktop sharing. Instructors can also manage remote attendees using built-in polling, status emojis, and smaller breakout rooms.
goodFor: Educational institutions and organisations that require a dedicated virtual classroom environment with interactive teaching tools.
watchOut: Deploying and scaling a multi-media web conferencing server can demand significant system resources and network bandwidth compared to simpler chat tools.
deployNotes: As a Java application, it typically requires a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination and sufficient server memory to support real-time media processing.
